newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.
newsitem.headline: German Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.

text.p: A total 28,000 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 39.437 European Currency Units (Ecus) per 100 kilos at the European Union tender, the German Intervention Board BLE said.
Out of the total, traders in France received 23,000 tonnes and traders in the UK received 5,000.
This week's award is the first in the 1997/98 series.
The cumulative tonnage for export from the 1996/97 crop last week totalled 2.530 million tonnes.
This week's result compares with the 23,000 tonnes awarded on Aug 7, 1996, the first weekly result recorded last season.
Last week, the EU awarded 35,600 tonnes of white sugar at a maximum rebate of 39.057 Ecus per 100 kilos.
